installation.scope: Source implementation, build and isolated application verification only; no app replacement or installer run.

diagnosis.minimal_old_runtime: Public Array2D resize creates null native QVariant cells. Legacy readers expose these and an authored dimensionless Quantity zero identically. Minimal 1x1 expected-fail test took 0.000s; this feedback loop preceded implementation inspection.
diagnosis.actual_old_native_gui: The stock material editor's Array2DModel/DoubleSpinBox delegate stores Float-column 0.314159. A read-only native Material copy bridge proves all three legacy Python readers instead return Quantity zero, without save/reload. Reproduced twice, 0.684s and 0.624s.
diagnosis.accessor_regression_red: Five new accessor checks failed while the legacy control passed before the accessor implementation.
diagnosis.independent_persistence_red: Native Array2D::getYAMLString/native loader helper roundtrip changes Quantity 123.45678901234567 to 123.46 and a tiny nonzero value to zero. Qualified native-persistence-red3.log, not the earlier harness attempts. Full Material::save roundtrip coverage was added later and passes on the final source.
diagnosis.review_regressions: Native red/green checks additionally cover dropped empty dimensions, inherited rows and overrides, rejected-save truncation/partial files, unsupported typed-null cells, and successful-save detachment of held native aliases.
harness_exclusions: GUI red1 failed its widget locator before reaching the product assertion.
The first persistence attempt encountered an unclassified display/unit exception; it is not precision-loss proof.
Persistence red2 used the wrong native getter and obtained a null pointer.
The development review-red log mixes useful inheritance/type-mismatch failures with an unclassified legacy-reader exception subcase; that exception alone is not used as product proof.
The final success-path test initially used an unqualified nested enum and did not compile; the corrected test then reproduced actual detached values before the fix.

implementation.interface: Additive readonly Materials.Array2D.TypedArray returns detached rows containing None, Quantity, float, int, bool and str. It retains precision, units and Unicode/NUL/surrogates. Unsupported populated or typed-null native types raise TypeError; inconsistent native dimensions/rows raise ValueError.
implementation.legacy_compatibility: Array/getRow/getValue retain Quantity coercion; setValue retains string-to-Quantity parsing.
implementation.persistence: Versioned FreeCAD.Array2D v1 cell records preserve native type/width/null state, exact IEEE floating/Quantity bits, all unit exponents, integer signedness/ranges, and UTF-16 code units. Ordinary physical and appearance saves retain empty dimensions. Inheritance distinguishes unresolved absence from explicit empty overrides and copies actual native rows independently.
implementation.atomic_library_save: QSaveFile with direct-write fallback disabled. Serialize a private Material, verify stream and atomic commit, then publish only the seven save-mutated metadata fields. Failure preserves existing card bytes and caller state; success retains held native property/array aliases.
implementation.reader_compatibility: The new reader accepts historical one/two-element Quantity-string representations and bare null/empty forms. Strict typed-format validation does not claim to tighten all historical row layouts.
implementation.old_application_limit: Older FreeCAD versions cannot read the new typed cards. No existing library is automatically rewritten; do not open/resave new cards with an older application.
implementation.fem_provenance: Both mesh-quality and native-accounting material fingerprints use the qualified typed accessor. The old null/zero and non-Quantity-column exclusions are removed only after native GUI, native wrapper and save/reopen qualification. Read-only copies remain stable; genuine semantic cell edits change both identities. Namespace overlap, unsupported/nonfinite values and missing typed interface remain fail closed.
implementation.fingerprint_type_scope: Python semantic types/values, not every QVariant storage width or typed-null metatype: native integer widths map to int, Float32/Float64 to float, supported nulls to None. Native card persistence separately retains the native storage distinctions.
implementation.migration: Use the ordinary writer to regenerate requests after fingerprint changes. No manual metadata edits, provenance bypass, historical-result promotion, mechanics change or solver recovery change.
implementation.fcstd_semantics: ShapeMaterial remains a UUID lookup into an available saved material library, not embedded unsaved material contents. Save the material before relying on document reopen.

clean_source_build.warning_limit: Existing Pivy stub-generation warnings are nonfatal; this is a successful clean-source incremental build, not a claim of a warning-free or from-empty-directory build.

focused_native.composition: 12 persistence, 11 TypedArray, 7 MaterialCards and one existing Array2D type check

native_pipeline.workflow: Existing real CAD/Gmsh/ordinary writer/native bundled solver/Current import witness retaining readonly material copies; exact saved historical AccountingData/Resultants and ordinary second solve remain verified.
native_pipeline.binary_limit: This is the unsigned build-resource solver, not the differently signed installed binary. No native solver source was changed by this fix.

native_gui_and_cold_restore.workflow: Actual stock GUI delegates author the mixed row; ordinary private User-library manager save/refresh, FCStd close/reopen and a separate cold Cmd process retain exact typed values, full canonical material identities and both FEM hashes with no metadata exclusions.
native_gui_and_cold_restore.null_fixture_origin: Separate public native Array2D.Columns/Rows setters; GUI row insertion authors zeros and is not claimed to produce invalid native null cells.
native_gui_and_cold_restore.custody: Actual native User-library and app-data paths proven strictly inside the owned profile before saves. Producers, supervisors, build modules, saved cards and FCStd documents hash-pinned; one build Materials image only. Native and supervisor PASS receipts, exit0, reaped processes, no timeout. Installed Materials/MatGui hashes protected before/after; no installation operation.

gates.independent_review: Two final read-only source audits signed off after actionable findings were reproduced and fixed. This is software review only.
gates.formatting: PASS standalone Black on changed FEM helper/tests; clang-format on native accessor/tests and changed library-save range; git diff --check.
gates.Rails: SKIPPED, not applicable: no Rails app/Gemfile/root package or importmap checks. Native FreeCAD gates apply.

scope_limits: Array3D and scalar persistence are unchanged. Array3D precision/inherited-save follow-up: FreeCAD-b7d.

General Array2D copy assignment appends rows; this independent source-inspected issue is tracked as FreeCAD-36b. This change uses fresh copies instead; no native GUI assignment reproduction is claimed.
Inherited appearance-array handling follows the same code path but has no separate dedicated inheritance test. Physical inheritance and flat physical/appearance empty-dimension saves are covered.
Cross-platform numeric-width rejection is implemented and validated for malformed inputs on this runtime, not runtime-qualified on every architecture.
Quantity display-format preferences are not physical payload and are not preserved by the typed persistence format.
